CBET Study Guide and Practice Tests

CBET Academy is a free CBET study guide and practice-test course for the AAMI/ACI Certified Biomedical Equipment Technician exam: sixty lessons organised by the exam's six domains, a printable memorization sheet, adaptive tutorials built from your misses, and unlimited CBET practice tests.

The exam at a glance

CodeCBET
Questions165
Time180 minutes
PassingThe real exam requires about 116 of 165 correct, roughly 70%. This course's official-format test uses 70%.
Course60 lessons across 9 units, about 10.5 hours of reading
CostFree

How the course works

  1. Cheat sheet. Everything the exam expects you to recall cold, printable.
  2. Starter test. A few questions per exam domain, with a confidence rating on each.
  3. Your tutorial. Lessons chosen from what you missed or guessed, each with a checkpoint and a deeper explanation.
  4. Practice tests and retraining. 50 questions, weighted like the real exam. Every miss is explained and feeds back into your lessons.
  5. 3 of your last 5 at 80%. That unlocks one full-length test on the real exam's clock: 165 questions in 180 minutes, at its real passing score of 70%. Pass it once and you are ready to book.

Every lesson, by unit

Questions people ask

How many questions are on the CBET exam?

165 multiple-choice questions in 3 hours, closed book, with a simple on-screen calculator. About 116 correct, roughly 70%, passes; ACI sets the exact cut score with a criterion-referenced method.

When is the CBET offered?

Twice a year, in May and November, at computer-based test centers. Applications open about three months before each window.

Who is eligible for the CBET?

Full certification needs an associate degree in electronics, technology, or science plus two years of full-time BMET work, or a US military biomed program plus two years, or four years of full-time work alone. With the degree, the program, or two years of work alone you can sit as a candidate and have five years to upgrade.

How much does the CBET cost?

In 2026 the exam is $410 for AAMI members and $460 for non-members. Certification is renewed every three years with continuing education.

How many practice tests should I take?

This course asks for three of your last five fifty-question practice tests at 80% or better, then one full-length test in the real exam's format at the real passing score. Most learners get there in six to ten tests.

Is the course free?

Yes. The lessons, the cheat sheet, and unlimited practice tests are free while the site launches.
